g.text: Look at the ash that came down.
Step on and look at the next.
Go out as far as the third.
Tell Ivy what the stones do.
Try the bark with a hand.
Reach for the big side branch.
Get off at the root end.
Go and compare it with the stones.
Walk back down to the piers.
Ask how long the mending takes.
Go back and look at the beck.
Try the ford by the sheep gate.
Go and look for the planks.
Try the sausage in Ivy's pocket.
Hold it up where she can see.
Put it on a flat stone at the edge.
Measure the gap she will not cross.
Go and find something to build with.
Go back to the piers first.
Poke about with a hazel stick.
Work out where the nothing is.
Poke along the top end too.
Go and get something built instead.
Head back up to the piers.
Try the willow roots at the bend.
Look in the shallows further down.
Get it as far as the piers.
Go back for anything else useful.
Go back to the stepping stones.
Go back to the fallen ash.
Make the gap into a stone.
Use the branch as a handrail.
Hold the far end for him.
Call her across the new stone.
Leave her to make her own mind up.
Keep going to the far roots.
Take one hand off to steady.
Tie the blue rope on for the rest.
Say it is not a bridge yet.
Hold it until the last nail.
Let go to look at the water.
